title: Ex-Trump Press Secretary Unloads on the Four Horsemen of the Trump-ocalypse
author: Prem Thakker
content:
Trumpworld is in absolute chaos. A [press
secretary](https://zeteo.com/p/7-things-to-know-about-the-new-insane) that
lasted [less than one business
week](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/10/16/trump-says-press-
secretary-katie-zacharia-should-reconsider-her-role/). Rumors that Trump's
[chief of staff](https://zeteo.com/p/trumps-white-house-chief-of-staff) is on
the ropes. A Trump ally [kicked
out](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/15/paolo-zampolli-fired-state-
department-trump-01121739) of the State Department. Trump Jr.'s ex [pushed
out](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/13/kimberly-guilfoyle-
ambassador-greece-step-down), amid allegations that she privately solicited
hundreds of thousands of dollars to pay off personal credit card debts.

And that's just what you know. But this week, **Zeteo** has revealed much more
about what's happening inside the top echelons of the administration, in our
new "Four Horsemen of the Trump-ocalypse" project - a series of profiles
cataloging the immense damage [Stephen Miller](https://zeteo.com/p/stephen-
miller-trump-running-world), [Marco Rubio](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-
cuck-marco-rubio-trump), [Pete Hegseth](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-
crimes-pete-hegseth), and [Mike Huckabee](https://zeteo.com/p/the-israel-
experience-with-mike-huckabee) have inflicted.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Sarah Matthews, who served as White House deputy press secretary during the
first Trump administration, joined **Prem** to unpack the series, and offer
her own insight on these four horsemen.

She described her first early impressions of Stephen Miller, years ago, and
why he'll seemingly never be pushed out.

**" He's been with Trump since the very beginning. And someone like that,
Trump values loyalty above all else, obviously - above qualifications,
competency, morality, anything. So someone like a Stephen Miller has been able
to survive and thrive in Trumpworld,"** she said. She added that, while many
Republicans privately don't approve of him,** "as of now, I don't really see a
universe in which he is forced out anytime soon."**

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/ex-trump-press-secretary-
unloads?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

And while she thinks Rubio has tried to be a **" good influence" **on the
administration, Matthews conceded, **" We have to remember, moving forward,
that he is complicit and he doesn't just get to distance himself from the
horrors and atrocities of Trump 2.0, no matter how much he wants to try to do
that."**

Matthews also shared what Republicans are saying about the rift between JD
Vance and Marco Rubio; what early warning signs she saw inside Trump 1.0; and
why, even months ago, Hegseth was the Trump cabinet official who terrified her
the most.
